description: This file defines a PHP class named EmployeeGender within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a composite display field class and specifies methods to identify the associated Data Transfer Object (DTO), the data fields used, and the entity aliases relevant to displaying the employee's gender information in reports.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents a report display field for employee gender, extending functionality from CombinedDisplayField to specify fields and DTO related to employee gender information.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, specifically EmployeeGender DTO.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of data fields relevant to this display field; here, it retrieves 'employee.gender'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the aliases of entities used in database queries; here, it returns 'employee'.
